title: Retail Cortex Code ML Lab
scenario: Predict each customer's net spend over the next 90 days from synthetic purchase history, then register, score and monitor the model in Snowflake.
expected_text: LOCATIONS 5 rows, CUSTOMERS 500 rows, TRANSACTIONS 50000 rows; NET_SPEND 13683214.77.
interface_notes:

- Project skills live in `.cortex/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` in your project folder.
- Review every change with Keep/Undo before accepting.
